title: Elijah on Mount Carmel

questions.question: Who hid 100 prophets of the Lord in caves?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:4 (ESV): "Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifties in a cave and fed them..."

questions.question: Who did Ahab call "You troubler of Israel"?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:17 (ESV): "When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, 'Is it you, you troubler of Israel?'"

questions.question: How many prophets of Baal were gathered at Mount Carmel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:19 (ESV): "...gather to me all Israel at Mount Carmel, and the 450 prophets of Baal..."

questions.question: What happened when the prophets of Baal called on their god?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:26 (ESV): "...But there was no voice, and no one answered."

questions.question: What happened when Elijah prayed?
options: The fire of the Lord fell and consumed the offering
questions.correctAnswer: The fire of the Lord fell and consumed the offering
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:38 (ESV): "Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the burnt offering and the wood and the stones and the dust..."

questions.question: What did Elijah mockingly suggest Baal was doing?
options: Musing, relieving himself, on a journey, or sleeping
questions.correctAnswer: Musing, relieving himself, on a journey, or sleeping
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:27 (ESV): "...Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is musing, or he is relieving himself, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep..."

questions.question: How much water did Elijah pour on the altar?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:33-34 (ESV): "Fill four jars with water... Do it a second time... Do it a third time." (4 x 3 = 12).

questions.question: What did the prophets of Baal do to get their god's attention?
options: Cried aloud and cut themselves with swords and lances
questions.correctAnswer: Cried aloud and cut themselves with swords and lances
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:28 (ESV): "And they cried aloud and cut themselves after their custom with swords and lances..."

questions.question: Where did Elijah kill the prophets of Baal?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:40 (ESV): "...And Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon and slaughtered them there."

questions.question: What signal indicated rain was coming?
options: A little cloud like a man's hand
questions.correctAnswer: A little cloud like a man's hand
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:44 (ESV): "...Behold, a little cloud like a man's hand is rising from the sea."

questions.question: What was Obadiah's position?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:3 (ESV): "And Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household..."

questions.question: How many stones did Elijah take to build the altar?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:31 (ESV): "Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob..."

questions.question: At what time did Elijah offer his prayer?
options: At the time of the offering of the oblation (evening sacrifice)
questions.correctAnswer: At the time of the offering of the oblation (evening sacrifice)
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:36 (ESV): "And at the time of the offering of the oblation, Elijah the prophet came near..."

questions.question: How far did Elijah run before Ahab's chariot?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:46 (ESV): "...and he ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel."

questions.question: What did the people say after the fire fell?
options: The LORD, he is God; the LORD, he is God
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD, he is God; the LORD, he is God
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:39 (ESV): "...The LORD, he is God; the LORD, he is God."

key_verse_text: And Elijah came near to all the people and said, “How long will you go limping between two different opinions? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” (ESV)
